buttons: Side power button: single click powers on or resets; double click powers off; long press enters download mode (the chip then boots into the ROM loader every reset until you single-click).
quirks: Opening its USB serial port with pyserial's defaults resets the chip, and into download mode: the OS raises DTR and RTS on open. Lower RTS before DTR (board_serial does).

An RTS reset right after flashing, or a firmware crash-and-reboot loop, can wedge the USB port: no output and esptool says 'No serial data received'. A USB re-enumeration recovers it (board_recover); otherwise unplug it.
If every reset prints 'boot:0x1 (DOWNLOAD...)' and 'waiting for download', the side button was long-pressed: ask the user to single-click it.
Console output is on the native USB-Serial/JTAG port (CONFIG_ESP_CONSOLE_USB_SERIAL_JTAG=y); there is no USB-UART bridge.
